physical.title: Physical clock
physical.description:
Optionally mirror this clock on a real one built from the Weasley Clock ESPHome firmware. Each person's hand is chosen when you edit that person.

**Calibrating:** tick *Pause*, save, press the device's *Home All Clock Hands* button, then adjust each *Hand N Position (Steps)* on the device until that hand points at the middle of position 1. Enter those numbers as the offsets below and untick *Pause*.

data.device_id: ESPHome clock device (leave empty for no physical clock)
data.steps_per_rev: Steps for one full turn of a hand
data.reverse: Positive steps turn the hands anticlockwise
data.paused: Pause (don't move the hands, e.g. while calibrating)
data.hand_1_offset: Hand 1: steps from home to position 1
data.hand_2_offset: Hand 2: steps from home to position 1
data.hand_3_offset: Hand 3: steps from home to position 1
data.hand_4_offset: Hand 4: steps from home to position 1
data.hand_5_offset: Hand 5: steps from home to position 1
data.hand_6_offset: Hand 6: steps from home to position 1
data.hand_7_offset: Hand 7: steps from home to position 1
data.hand_8_offset: Hand 8: steps from home to position 1
